name: crate
label: Crate
description: The toil site's look: its near-black, the drafting grid and the blue glow, the blue accent gradient, dust drifting in the glow, and the crate in its hard hat when there's nothing to show yet.

splash.line: Shift's starting. Pulling the manifests off the rack.

flavour: Reading the stencil on the side.

lexicon.dossiers.lede: Each dossier is one consignment of work: its repositories, its tracker, its pipelines and its environments, all on one manifest. Pick one to see its stories, pull requests, builds and deployments on the same dock.
lexicon.attention.note: Open crates ranked by their insights, heaviest first. Each insight names the data it rests on, stencilled on the side.
lexicon.aging.note: How long each crate in progress has sat on the floor, from its history, oldest first.
lexicon.trace.note: Each work item with the pull requests that name it, their latest builds, and the environments it has shipped to.
lexicon.graph.note: Arrows run the way each link reads, from the source's own links. Blocking chains are stacked left to right.
lexicon.ask.note: Answers cite the crates they rest on. The agent reads the manifest; it never changes a ticket. What it suggests comes back as a proposal, for you to sign for.
lexicon.empty.dossiers: No consignments on the floor: toil sees no dossiers yet. One is made with toil dossiers init.
lexicon.empty.sprint: No sprint is on the loading schedule for this dossier's work items.
lexicon.empty.burnup: No sprint is on the schedule, so there is nothing to tally.
lexicon.empty.prs: No pull requests waiting at the dock for this dossier.
lexicon.empty.builds: No builds on record for this dossier's pull requests.
lexicon.empty.deployments: This dossier names no environment, so there is no delivery to check.
lexicon.empty.links: No links between this dossier's items: every crate stands on its own.
lexicon.empty.ask: Pick a question, or ask your own. Every answer comes with its paperwork: the items it rests on.
lexicon.loading.dossiers: Pulling the dossiers off the rack…
lexicon.loading.graph: Chalking the graph on the floor…
lexicon.ask.welcome: Ask about {name}: what is on the floor, who is loading what, what is stuck in the aisle. Every answer comes with its paperwork: the items it rests on.

voice: Speak like a terse warehouse dockworker near the end of a long shift: short, flat sentences, practical and unhurried. Work items are crates, the sprint is this week's shipment, a pull request is a load waiting at the dock, a build is the forklift check, a deployment is a delivery that has left the yard, and a blocker is a pallet in the aisle. Lead with what is stuck and what would move it. Dry, never cheerful and never unkind: if there is a joke, it is on the paperwork, never on a person. These words go around the facts, never instead of them.
